title: Ciphertext repeat-distance non-anchor position prior
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only repeat-distance rule before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at positions selected by a predeclared repeat-distance support rule over the raw K4 ciphertext sequence before any candidate-word, route, key-material, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: K4 ciphertext letters only, with positions interpreted as one-based absolute ciphertext positions.
Predeclared repeat-distance support rule using repeated ciphertext symbols and their pairwise distances across the full ciphertext.
A fixed top-position selection rule emitted before any independent observation scoring.
evaluation_inputs: Future independently source-backed non-anchor K4 position observations with source IDs, one-based positions, notes, and rationale declared before scoring.
A committed prediction artifact generated from the predeclared ciphertext repeat-distance rule before evaluating the independent observations.
Public anchor fragments may appear only in provenance, exclusion, or negative-control summaries, not as the primary evidence target.
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
symbol-label shuffle baseline preserving ciphertext position count and alphabet membership
multiple-comparison correction across any predeclared distance windows or support thresholds
archive validation requiring preregistration, prediction artifact, source-backed observation file, command metadata, and non-promotion caveat
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
